summary: Maniac Mansion entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Maniac Mansion
entries.definitive_edition: GOG/Steam PC package with Original and Enhanced DOS versions documented

emulation.emulator: ScummVM or DOSBox; NES emulator only for port comparison
emulation.notes: Use current PC package for primary; compare original media/hardware only if version accuracy matters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original platform hardware/assets for each variant; PC package for practical current access

primary.version: GOG/Steam ScummVM package with Original and Enhanced versions documented
primary.why: The current PC storefront package is the most practical route and it includes both Original and Enhanced versions. NES and other computer ports preserve important version differences, including Nintendo censorship and interface/audio changes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG or Steam PC package through ScummVM/DOSBox. Record Original versus Enhanced version, ScummVM/DOSBox version, audio/device, save state, character trio, route/ending, and whether NES/C64/Amiga/Apple II versions were compared.

secondary.why: The NES version edits content and differs from the PC baseline.

secondary.platform: C64 / Apple II / Amiga / Atari ST / Macintosh
secondary.why: The PC package is practical, but not every release looks/sounds the same.

all_releases.platform: Commodore 64 / Apple II and original computer versions
all_releases.fidelity: Original SCUMM release family with platform-specific graphics/audio/interface.

all_releases.platform: DOS Original and Enhanced versions on current PC storefronts
all_releases.fidelity: Current PC package route including Original and Enhanced DOS versions.
all_releases.reason: primary: practical current route with both PC variants.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port with content edits/censorship and interface changes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC package is the practical complete route, while NES and older computer versions preserve distinct censored or platform-specific behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Original versus Enhanced variant and do not treat the NES port as content-identical.
